name: Synthetic training HARA library (NOT real project data)
note: Illustrative entries for demonstration only. Replace with your organisation's approved HARA library.

situations.name: Vehicle in a crash or emergency

entries.hazard: Unintended unlocking of doors while driving may allow a door to open during a manoeuvre

rationale.S: Ejection or collision risk with an opened door at speed
rationale.E: Door opening while driving is a rare combination
rationale.C: Driver can often react but occupants may not

entries.hazard: Loss of central locking prevents unlocking doors after an impact and delays occupant rescue
entries.situation: Vehicle in a crash or emergency

rationale.S: Delayed rescue can be life threatening
rationale.E: Crash combined with locking failure is rare
rationale.C: Manual unlocking exists but can be difficult

entries.function: Automatic door locking above speed threshold
entries.hazard: Auto-lock does not engage, doors remain unlocked at speed
Loss of headlamps at night reduces visibility and increases collision risk

rationale.E: Night driving on highways is common
rationale.C: Driver can slow down using hazard lights

entries.hazard: Unintended full-beam activation dazzles oncoming drivers
Erratic vehicle speed value causes dependent functions to act on wrong speed information

rationale.S: Wrong speed used by safety relevant functions
rationale.C: Driver cannot detect a silent value error

entries.hazard: Vehicle speed reported too low keeps speed dependent locking or warning from triggering
Loss of wiper function in heavy rain reduces visibility

rationale.E: Heavy rain at speed is not frequent
rationale.C: Driver can reduce speed and stop

entries.hazard: Brake lights do not illuminate when braking, following driver does not react

rationale.S: Rear end collision at moderate speed
rationale.C: Following driver can often avoid collision

entries.hazard: Open door not detected, vehicle moves with a door insufficiently latched

rationale.S: Door may open when starting to drive
